name: Trade in Channel
summary: This EA trades within a price channel, identifying channel boundaries and executing trades on breakout or reversal signals. It automatically detects channel highs and lows, then enters positions when price action confirms a breakout or bounce from channel edges. The system includes built-in stop loss and take profit management based on channel dimensions.
summary_zh: 该EA在价格通道内进行交易，自动识别通道上下边界，并在价格突破或反弹时执行交易。系统根据通道宽度自动计算止损和止盈水平，实现通道突破与通道内反转相结合的交易策略。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于价格通道的突破与回归交易。EA通过识别一定周期内的最高价和最低价来构建价格通道，当价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于通道突破策略。同时，当价格触及通道边界后反弹时，也可能触发通道内反转交易。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、通道反向边界平仓以及时间过滤平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，止损距离根据通道宽度动态调整，确保风险与市场波动性相匹配。整体策略逻辑清晰，但通道识别在趋势转折时可能出现滞后。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on price channel breakout and mean reversion trading. The EA constructs a price channel by identifying the highest high and lowest low over a specified lookback period, then enters long positions when price breaks above the upper channel boundary and short positions when price breaks below the lower boundary. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss levels calculated from channel width, reverse channel boundary exits, and optional time-based filters. Position sizing can use either fixed lots or dynamically calculated lots based on account balance and risk percentage. Money management adjusts stop loss distance according to channel width, ensuring risk is proportional to market volatility. The overall strategy logic is clear and systematic, but channel identification may lag during trend transitions, leading to false breakouts.

parameters.name: ChannelPeriod
parameters.description: 通道计算周期，用于确定最高价和最低价的回溯K线数
parameters.description_en: Channel calculation period for highest/lowest lookback bars

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，基于通道宽度动态调整

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

parameters.name: TimeFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用交易时间过滤

parameters.name: BreakoutMode
parameters.description: 是否使用突破模式入场，否则使用反转模式
parameters.description_en: Use breakout mode entry; otherwise reversal mode

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，通道识别方法简单直观，易于理解和优化
止损距离根据通道宽度动态调整，风险控制与市场波动性相匹配
支持突破和反转两种交易模式，适应不同市场行情
pros_en: Clear strategy logic with intuitive channel identification method that is easy to understand and optimize
Dynamic stop loss adjustment based on channel width ensures risk control matches market volatility
Supports both breakout and reversal trading modes, adaptable to different market conditions
cons: 通道识别基于历史极值，在趋势转折点容易产生滞后和虚假突破
缺乏成交量确认和多重时间框架验证，入场信号可靠性有限
没有内置的加仓或仓位调整机制，单笔交易风险固定
cons_en: Channel identification based on historical extremes lags during trend transitions, producing false breakouts
Lacks volume confirmation and multi-timeframe verification, limiting entry signal reliability
No built-in position scaling or adjustment mechanism, resulting in fixed per-trade risk exposure
improvements: 增加多时间框架通道确认，例如在H1通道突破时检查H4趋势方向一致性
加入ATR或布林带作为通道宽度的补充过滤条件，减少虚假突破
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe channel confirmation, such as checking H4 trend direction alignment when H1 channel breakout occurs
Incorporate ATR or Bollinger Bands as supplementary channel width filters to reduce false breakouts

risk_points: 通道突破在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数模式没有根据账户资金动态调整，小账户可能面临过度风险
risk_points_en: Channel breakouts in ranging markets easily generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses
Fixed lot mode does not dynamically adjust based on account equity, potentially exposing small accounts to excessive risk
